title: Compare results across random seeds
description: You collect the best final fitness from five seeded runs.
source: draft: codex free model + edit: codex

steps.description: You start an empty results list and create a configuration for each seed. Each iteration increments the seed from SEED by s.
You call evolve with verbose=False and retain fit[0] from each run. The function returns these best fitness values as an array.

steps.question: Do all five recorded seeds reach the same best fitness?
steps.answer: Four entries print as -0., while one is -0.99496. The recorded runs therefore have different final results.

steps.description: You print the five results with their mean and standard deviation.
